title: Practitioner Settlements
description: Use this page to determine and approve the practitioner's amount after the session ends, then credit it to their platform wallet. This page does not transfer money to the practitioner's bank account.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Session code, settlement, practitioner or patient

integrity.walletCurrencyMismatch: Approval is unavailable because the final entitlement currency does not match the practitioner wallet currency. Refresh the data or contact technical support.

states.emptyDescription: Settlements will appear here when a completed session enters accounting review.

emptyNeedsReview.title: No settlements need review
emptyNeedsReview.description: New completed-session settlements will appear here.

emptyCredited.title: No credited settlements
emptyCredited.description: Settlements credited to practitioner wallets will appear here.

emptyTransferred.title: No transferred settlements
emptyTransferred.description: Settlements recorded as transferred to practitioners will appear here.

emptyAll.title: No settlements found
emptyAll.description: Try changing the filters or search term.

states.actionError: The action could not be completed.

detail.title: Settlement detail
detail.appendOnly: Adjustments are recorded in the financial history.
detail.decisionNote: Review the session, amount, and adjustments before approving the practitioner's entitlement. Approval credits the final amount to the practitioner's platform wallet only.
detail.readOnly: This settlement is read-only because its accounting decision is already complete.
detail.externalTransferNote: Use this action only after the real transfer has been completed to the practitioner's bank account or external payout method. Confirmation records the transfer and debits the practitioner's platform balance.
detail.transferRecorded: The external transfer has already been recorded.

modals.adjustmentDescription: Add a reviewed adjustment. This does not credit the wallet by itself.
modals.approveDescription: The final amount will be approved and credited to the practitioner's platform wallet. No bank or external transfer will be performed in this step.
modals.rejectDescription: A reason is required and the settlement will not credit the wallet.
modals.payoutDescription: This records an external transfer that has already been completed. It does not send money automatically.
modals.overrideReasonPlaceholder: Explain why the actual amount differs
modals.legacyFxUnavailable: FX snapshot unavailable for this legacy transfer
modals.payoutWarning: This records an external transfer that has already been completed; it does not send money automatically.
modals.noExternalTransfer: This approves the entitlement and credits the wallet. No external transfer is performed in this step.
